tmp:0683: shemirat ha-dibbur — guarding one's speech from blemish, whose neglect (Babylonian blurring of speech) breeds pride and exiles the Shekhinah
tmp:0684: lomed Torah — the act of Torah study as prerequisite for valid prayer ('one who turns his ear from Torah, his prayer is abomination')
tmp:0685: the possibility of praying — capacity for prayer, conditional on Torah study (impossible for the am ha-aretz who shuns Torah)
tmp:0687: the possibility of drawing near to holiness — approach to kedushah attainable only via boldness ('be bold as a leopard')
tmp:0688: awakening immediately and repenting right after sin — prompt teshuvah before straying far from the good path
tmp:0689: the ease of returning to one's place — easy restoration to one's spiritual station granted by immediate repentance
tmp:0690: being nothing and naught in one's own eyes (efes va-ayin) — self-nullifying humility that alone merits perfected honor and speech
tmp:0693: making converts (gerim) — the act of bringing gentiles to conversion, effected through charity to Torah scholars ('wealth adds many friends')
tmp:0694: Ekyeh spelled out to 161 (KS"A) — the holy Name Ekyeh in its 161-gematria expansion, aspect of 'expert in running' (baki be-ratzo) for ascent
tmp:0696: arbeh (locust) — the locust whose garment is 'from and of itself,' symbol of the Vacated Space (chalal ha-panui) and its self-generated garment/tzimtzum
tmp:0699: aryeh (lion) — the supernal lion that descends to consume offerings, identified with etzem (bone) per Tikkunei Zohar 3

tmp:0706: 'lifnei Hashem Elokeikhem' ('before the Lord your God') — verse-phrase denoting the Land of Israel ('whoever dwells in it is as one who has a God')

tmp:0709: 'eretz natnah yevulah' ('the earth has given its yield,' Ps. 67:7) — verse-phrase for peace/healing, opposite of dispute (Canaan)

tmp:0721: ishto rishonah — one's first wife (whose death shortens one's steps), identified with Shabbat as Israel's designated mate
